simple.meaning: alive ; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong ; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חַי (H2416) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a n-m n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 503 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
